scripts.vendor: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf \"$tmp\"" EXIT; (cd "$tmp" && bun init -y >/dev/null && bun add preact@10 htm@3 >/dev/null); mkdir -p vendor; cp "$tmp/node_modules/preact/dist/preact.module.js" vendor/preact.module.js; cp "$tmp/node_modules/htm/dist/htm.module.js" vendor/htm.module.js; echo "vendored preact and htm into vendor/"'
